handbookNote: Idaho Commercial Driver's License Manual (2022 CDL Testing System, July 2026 Edition), published by the Idaho Transportation Department (ITD) Division of Motor Vehicles -- fetched directly from itd.idaho.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/CDL-manual.pdf on 2026-08-21 (full text extracted via pdftotext to scratchpad/id_cdl_research/id_cdl_manual.txt, 10,110 lines) -- price matches this project's established CDL tier ($6.99). Real exam mechanics: unlike several prior CDL-track states where item counts could not be confirmed on an official source, the Idaho manual itself contains an official 'Knowledge Test Information' table (Section 1 - Introduction, page 1) giving exact question counts and minimum-correct-to-pass for every Idaho CDL knowledge test -- General Knowledge: 50 questions / 40 correct to pass; Hazardous Materials: 30 questions / 24 correct; Air Brakes: 25 questions / 20 correct; Combination Vehicles: 20 questions / 16 correct; Tank Vehicles: 20 questions / 16 correct; Doubles/Triples: 20 questions / 16 correct; Passenger Vehicles: 20 questions / 16 correct; School Busses: 20 questions / 16 correct -- every test computes to exactly the 80% minimum passing score that is federally standardized under 49 CFR 383.135(a). The same page/fee schedule also confirms Idaho's CDL license fee structure (1-year $15 / 3-year $30 / 4-year $40 / 8-year $60 / seasonal 180-day $44, Commercial Learner's Permit $29, duplicate $20, license upgrade $30, add-endorsement $20, written test $5 each) and that skills testing is administered through county CDL license offices and licensed third-party CDL examiners (examiner fee varies, up to $190 per Idaho Code 49-306(10)), distinct from the flat $10 county CDL license fee portion of the skills test. Content-depth rationale: this is the AAMVA-authored 2022 CDL Testing System manual (the newer AAMVA model revision, distinct from the older 2005 model used by some earlier-built states in this project), covering Introduction/licensing (CDL Classes A/B/C, six endorsements H/N/P/S/T/X, CLP rules, medical certification/self-certification, interstate/intrastate commerce status, disqualifications and out-of-service violations), Driving Safely, Transporting Cargo Safely, Transporting Passengers Safely, Air Brakes, Combination Vehicles, Doubles and Triples, Tank Vehicles, Hazardous Materials (shipping papers/labels/placarding plus loading/route/emergency rules), School Buses, Vehicle Inspection Test, Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, and On-Road Driving Testing -- supporting a large, non-repetitive, well-grounded question pool. Every question in this bank is grounded in a specific passage of the fetched official Idaho manual text cited in that question's source_note; none are invented, generic, or borrowed from another state's numbers.
